subject: Welcome to Netflix — you're all set
body:
Hi,

Thanks for joining Netflix! Your Standard plan is now active.
You can start watching right away on any device.

Enjoy the show.
The Netflix Team

subject: Your Netflix plan price is changing
body:
Hi,

Starting with your next billing date, your Standard plan will increase from $13.99 to $15.49 per month.
No action is needed if you'd like to keep your current plan.

The Netflix Team

subject: Your Netflix payment receipt
body:
Hi,

Your monthly Netflix subscription payment of $15.49 was successful.
Next billing date: October 12, 2026.

Thanks for being a member.
The Netflix Team

subject: Your automatic payment was processed

subject: Welcome to Google One
body:
Hi,

Hi,

Your Google One 200GB plan has renewed for $2.99/month.
